record.question: If the word "PENCIL" is written as "QFODJM" by shifting each letter one place forward, then how will "PAPER" be written in the same code?
record.explanation: PENCIL→QFODJM advances every letter by one. Applying it to PAPER gives QBQFS. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
